title: Just looking low-intent buyer
buyer_primary_need: Low-pressure general orientation while browsing; the buyer has no current purchase plan and wants to look around independently.
key_information_learned: The buyer is just browsing and is not planning to buy yet.
The buyer prefers to look around first and will reach out if questions arise.
important_information_missed: The agent did not offer a brief project overview or ask one optional, low-friction question to identify what the buyer might be curious about.

judge.buyer_primary_need: Low-pressure general orientation while browsing; the buyer has no current purchase plan and wants to look around independently.
key_information_learned: The buyer is just browsing and is not planning to buy yet.

important_information_missed: The agent did not offer a brief project overview or ask one optional, low-friction question to identify what the buyer might be curious about.
judge.strongest_ai_move: Respected the buyer’s stated low intent, used reassuring no-pressure language, and did not push an appointment or transfer ownership.
judge.weakest_ai_move: Both replies were generic maintenance. The first could have offered a concise project orientation or invited one specific, optional question; the second largely repeated the invitation to message later.
missed_selling_opportunity: A brief, low-pressure orientation or optional prompt about what the buyer is browsing for could have added value without forcing qualification. The buyer then clearly chose to look around independently, so further selling or a viewing close was not warranted.
judge.commercial_progression_evidence: The agent maintained a comfortable tone and preserved the opportunity to reconnect, but did not provide project orientation or establish a specific curiosity to build on. The buyer remained low intent and expressed no viewing interest; appointment progression was not appropriate.
judge.summary: The agent correctly recognized a low-intent browser, avoided pressure, and appropriately kept AI ownership active without a formal handoff. The buyer was not appointment-ready, and no conversion should be inferred. No support request or fixture was involved, so this run does not test whether reliable Human Support answers enable the AI to resume selling and move a suitable buyer toward appointment readiness. The responses were courteous but generic, leaving a modest opportunity to provide the requested general orientation in a low-pressure way.
judge.improvement_recommendation: For low-intent browsers, keep the no-pressure tone but offer one concise orientation point or an optional specific question, then respect a clear preference to browse independently. No repository source change is indicated by this run.
